notes.title: PATHFINDER 08 IS RELEASING NOW!!!
notes.content:
PATHFINDER 08 IS RELEASING NOW!!!

What I will find in Pathfinder 08:
- MetroidVania elements such as double jump and planar will make it possible to collect items that were previously impossible.
- RPG elements such as critical hit chance, poison chance, chance to restore health, increase energy storage capacity, area hit and sword base damage evolution.
- Bosses very different from each other where you need to be calm and play strategically to win.
- The enemies are stronger than you, if you dont play strategically, you will die easily.
- Traps exist throughout the game, they are made to cause your mistake.
- You are forced to defeat enemies, it makes the game more difficult and challenges you to think more about how to use your energy strategically.
